May the panel send a user back to this URL after sign-in? Only origins
of registered, non-revoked apps qualify, so `?redirect=` on the panel
can never act as an open redirector. Same trust set as dynamic CORS.

info.title: Zar Auth API
info.description: Authentication and authorization service for zar.mx

role.description: Role to assign to the user.

email.description: Email address for the new account. Normalized to lowercase.

password.description: Account password. Must be strong: mix of upper/lowercase, number, and symbol.

lang.description:
Language for the account's emails ("en" default). Consumer apps pass
the language of the page the user signed up from.

email.description: Email address of the account to recover.

token.description: Single-use token from the invitation email.

password.description: New password. Must be strong: mix of upper/lowercase, number, and symbol.

newPassword.description: New password. Must be strong: mix of upper/lowercase, number, and symbol.

signupEnabled.description:
Allows direct public sign-up on auth.zar.mx itself. App-mediated
sign-up is governed per app, not by this flag.

public.description: Public apps accept any zar user; private apps require access grants.

confidential.description:
Server-side app whose key never reaches a browser. Only confidential
apps may forward their visitor's X-Client-IP / X-Client-User-Agent.

redirectUris.description:
OAuth (PKCE) callback URIs, matched exactly. https URLs or custom
schemes such as "xp24://auth/callback"; http only for localhost.

message.example: Hi, I need a website for my shop.

lang.description: Language of the page the form was on; drives the stored locale.

website.description:
Honeypot: a hidden field real visitors never fill. A non-empty value
makes the request succeed without storing or sending anything.

code_verifier.description: authorization_code: the PKCE verifier the challenge was built from.

redirect_uri.description: authorization_code: must equal the redirect_uri used to get the code.

device_name.description: authorization_code: optional label shown in the user's device list.

refresh_token.description: refresh_token: the current refresh token (rotated on every use).
